bias.zh: 中性 · 守住均线，受制于 $352

read.en: Alphabet rose 0.5% on Oct 15 to $349.22 after dipping to $340.61. It closed just above its 10-day ($349.2), above the 30-day ($344.8) and 200-day ($340.8), and below the 5-day ($351.0) and falling 100-day ($351.4). MACD is still above its signal (since Oct 5) but the histogram is narrowing toward a cross, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 8 ($338.9), and RSI is 53.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月15日盘中下探 $340.61 后回升，上涨 0.5%，收于 $349.22。股价收于 10 日均线（$349.2）略上方，位于 30 日（$344.8）和 200 日均线（$340.8）上方，并在 5 日（$351.0）和下行的 100 日均线（$351.4）下方。MACD 仍位于信号线上方（自 10月5日起），但柱状图收窄、接近交叉，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看多（$338.9），RSI 为 53。

read.en: Little changed versus the previous read: the dip briefly undercut the $344–349 average zone but the close recovered it, and the $352 cap (100 and 5-day averages, Oct 15 high $352.13) held. Above it are $359.4 (Oct 13–14 highs) and $364 (Sep 22 high). Support is $345, then $339–341 (SAR and 200-day average) and $327.7 (Sep 10 low). A close above $352 would target $359.4.
read.zh: 较上次解读变化不大：盘中回落一度跌破 $344–349 均线区域，但收盘收复，$352 压力（100 日和 5 日均线、10月15日高点 $352.13）未被突破。其上为 $359.4（10月13–14日高点）和 $364（9月22日高点）。支撑为 $345，其次 $339–341（SAR 及 200 日均线）和 $327.7（9月10日低点）。若收盘站上 $352，目标看 $359.4。

r.en: Sep 22 high, top of the 3-week range
